name: Pyromancer: Molten Storm and Pyromaniac modify their spenders (#1355, #793)
contract: #1355, #793: Molten Storm 805483 is family 30 with e1 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER misc 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) value 9+1 = +10 and e2 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) value +10%, both class mask A 0x10 = Lava Shard (803950). Pyromaniac 500166 e1 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER misc 7 value 4+1 = +5 with masks A 0x200000 (Explode 800792), B 0x8000 (Flames of Neltharion 801915), C 0x800000; e2 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT) +10% with mask A 0x200 (Blaze 805500). The core applies them natively in Unit::SpellDoneCritChance (Unit.cpp:9694) and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:9367); no module code touches either passive. Asserts the native spell modifiers per spell are nil before and the recorded value after learning, and that Pyromaniac does not touch Lava Shard (its mask is A 0x10, not in Pyromaniac's masks).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Lava Shard crit modifier starts at 0
Lava Shard damage modifier starts neutral
Flames of Neltharion crit modifier starts at 0
Molten Storm adds 10 crit to Lava Shard
Molten Storm adds 10% damage to Lava Shard
Pyromaniac adds 5 crit to Flames of Neltharion
Pyromaniac adds 10% periodic damage to Blaze
Pyromaniac leaves Lava Shard crit at Molten Storm's 10
Unlearning Pyromaniac removes the Explode crit
Unlearning Molten Storm removes the Lava Shard crit
